2024-07-16 | #011  

Standardisation and streamlining of the MBC 300 & 700 range

We would like to inform you about a standardisation of our MBC 300 and 700 product range.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-011_MBC-300-700-standardisation_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. Within the MBC 300 and 700 product range we currently have two different actuator variants. We have decided to standardise the product range to the actuator with the more sustainable metal housing.

This harmonisation only affects the actuator and has no effect on the behaviour of the safety valves, the regulator or the flow rate as the body remains the same.

Date of changeover in our production: February 03, 2025

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-011_MBC-300-700-standardisation_1R0. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. As part of this standardisation, some items will be discontinued with and without identical replacements (see pages 5-6). Please contact your sales representative if you have any questions.

Discontinued articles:

- Last order date: January 31, 2025

- Last delivery date: March 31, 2025

We appreciate your understanding and support during this transition period. Should you have any questions or require further information, our Supportcenter is always available to assist you.

Changeover   Identical
